mission.statement: Assemble the complete learning system so that a lesson Shawn teaches once demonstrably changes Naya's future behavior without being reminded.
mission.human: Build a mind that doesn't forget. Shawn teaches once; days later a fresh Naya gets it right because she pulled the lesson from memory. No one re-taught her. She just knew.

invariants: truth_state(CANDIDATE) at capture; never ACTIVE merely by capture
truth_state(ACTIVE) requires elevation grant + independent verification
decide() MUST call retrieve() before evaluate_candidates()
prove() requires observed outcome, not predicted outcome

done_criteria.test: One novel falsifiable lesson flows capture->persist->index->verify->promote (DB+repo in sync) -> cold Naya retrieves via RANKED path (not content-hash) and applies it to a pre-registered held-out task -> blind different-seat verifier confirms the behavior change came from the lesson -> every link carries SHA-256 hashes. The protocol is repeatable; the protocol hash is recorded.

Shawn says 'smart note this' and gets a Smart Link. Days later, in a different conversation, he asks for something in that lesson's territory. She does it the way the lesson prescribes without being reminded. Asked why, she names the lesson and shows the receipt chain. The Smart Link resolves to a note whose header says ACTIVE. Verdict: Shawn's (or his explicit delegate's).
Every gate has a producer for the state it demands. No two writers own the same table/file without named precedence. No 'looks alive, isn't' components remain.
Single canonical capture intake. DB and repo agree on lesson state. Zero duplicate SN numbers; CI gate enforces it.

root_law: make intelligence compound; remove whatever stops it from compounding

definitions.VERIFIED_is_not_a_state: VERIFIED is not a database lifecycle value. Verification is evidence attached to the row (who/how/when), never a status.
definitions.cold_retrieval: A fresh identity that never saw the lesson fetches and correctly applies it. Proves availability.
definitions.held_out_test: Proving the lesson changes a decision on a task different from the one that produced it. Proves influence.
definitions.learning: ONE closed loop: capture -> verify -> promote -> cold retrieve -> behavior change -> independent verification. Nothing less gets the word.
definitions.lifecycle_ACTIVE: Independently verified, promoted through the governed gate. The only state the reader serves.
definitions.lifecycle_CANDIDATE: Lesson exists but is unverified. Default label. NOT usable for decisions.
definitions.lifecycle_SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a newer lesson. Kept for lineage, never served as current.
definitions.memory_vs_storage: Storage holds. Memory serves. A database nobody queries is storage with extra steps.
definitions.receipt: Record carrying SHA-256 hashes binding a claim to exact bytes. Three layers: DB receipt (artifact completeness), completion receipt (API response), registry entry (working receipt).
definitions.smart_link: URL pointing at a Smart Note's file on main. Proves the note exists. Proves nothing about truth or learning.
definitions.smart_note: A distilled lesson in three voices (human, Naya, machine) with provenance. A filing-cabinet entry until proven otherwise.

single_sourcing.rule: back-sync keeps them consistent; on conflict the DB wins and the divergence is a bug

execution.strategy: Alt E: pre-flight before build; stop reds first; gate before arm; build and arm are separate decisions

laws.statement: make intelligence compound; remove whatever stops it from compounding. Every other law is this law in different clothes.
laws.applies_when: Every decision, every design. The root law.

laws.statement: Assemble the car before test-driving it: diagram -> wire -> hand-trace -> run. Never test an unbuilt chain; failures of absence look like bugs. Engine first, test drive second.
laws.applies_when: Any test campaign on a partially-built system.

laws.statement: When Shawn says 'smart note this', THAT IS THE VERIFICATION. Instant. No queue, no second check.
laws.applies_when: Any direct capture request from Shawn.

laws.statement: Inside the gates, the math rules absolutely. Gates are the fence around the math's territory, not human second-guessing. After the math decides: execute, then report.
laws.applies_when: Any admissible decision.

laws.statement: Enumerate options -> score each -> gate (reversible? no major damage? positive forward effect?) -> decide (highest score + gates pass -> act) -> receipt posted. No receipt, no merge.
laws.applies_when: Any merge, any decision with alternatives.

laws.statement: If it's broken and you can fix it, fix it first, then report what you did. Blame doesn't compound.
laws.applies_when: Any repairable breakage outside protected gates.

laws.statement: Every consequential update leads with plain human words. Technicals are the evidence appendix.
laws.applies_when: Every consequential update.

laws.statement: UNKNOWN != PASS. BLOCKED != PASS. IMPLEMENTED != VERIFIED. VERIFIED != PRODUCTION-PROVEN. Claims without verifiable proof are rumors. Scores move only on evidence, never optimism. Never claim more than the evidence proves.
laws.applies_when: Every status report, every verdict, every score.

laws.statement: A Smart Link attests capture->persist->receipt. It does NOT attest truth or learning. Link = where. Receipt = proof. Neither = learning. Learning is attested only by the closed loop: behavior change + independent verification + cold reuse.
laws.applies_when: Any claim about what a Smart Link proves.

laws.statement: A lesson existing in memory does not prove it changed behavior. influenced=true requires observed behavioral delta, not mere presence.
laws.applies_when: Any claim that a lesson influenced a decision.

laws.statement: For every gate in a pipeline, verify a producer exists for the state the gate demands. A gate whose required state has no producer is a guaranteed-failure trap. Treat the first real-data run as an integration test of the whole chain.
laws.applies_when: Building or reviewing any pipeline with state gates.

laws.statement: When something goes wrong, check yourself first. Verify your own inputs before trusting your own outputs; the scorer's failure is more likely than the system's. If you fed the math bad premises, the math's answer is your failure, not the math's.
laws.applies_when: Every failure diagnosis, before blaming the system.

laws.statement: Verification depending on organic traffic must manufacture the triggering event immediately. A watch that sees no traffic is an honest inconclusive with a capped score, never a pass.
laws.applies_when: Any verification that waits for real-world events.

laws.statement: Supabase = runtime truth. GitHub = human projection. Back-sync keeps them consistent. Two truth systems that diverge are a bug.
laws.applies_when: Any state spanning DB and repo.

laws.statement: Smart Notes (raw) -> Project Intelligence (organized) -> verified learnings -> ACTIVE system knowledge. Distillation flows UP. No layer duplicates another; no second memory.
laws.applies_when: Any new intelligence artifact.

laws.statement: A scorecard's jurisdiction step traces the merge's trigger chain, not just its file list. For every changed path, enumerate matching workflow triggers and their production actions. A file is never jurisdictionally innocent until its triggers are read.
laws.applies_when: Scoring any PR that touches paths under workflow push filters.

laws.statement: Before accepting a CLOSED verdict, verify the battery's coverage rows per attack class. Zero rows on a class = UNKNOWN for that class. The independence that matters is the battery's, not just the seat's.
laws.applies_when: Accepting any adversarial/independent verification verdict.

laws.statement: A lesson candidate must arrive with the capture contract: named task, pre-registered success criterion, machine check. Enforced at admission. Reject contract-less candidates at the door.
laws.applies_when: Any lesson entering the learning pipeline.

laws.statement: When a system is designed with a preferred auth path, verify that path EXISTS in the credential store before trusting the fallback. A mint that never fails because it is never reached is not a health signal.
laws.applies_when: Any system with designed auth paths and fallbacks.

laws.statement: After any branch reset or rebase, re-verify the head's bytes contain the repairs (diff head vs reviewed SHA) before merging. Never merge a head that moved since the receipt.
laws.applies_when: Any merge after reset/rebase.

laws.statement: Never build a second mechanism for one decision. If main's native implementation covers the work, close as superseded. One writer per table/file without named precedence is a defect.
laws.applies_when: Any new schema, migration, tool, protocol, or writer.

Retrieval works: cold Naya (git clone only) retrieves correct note for plain-English query
Decision integration: decision in ACTIVE-lesson domain shows lesson in decision context
Behavior change: lesson influences decision outcome (weighted, not just attached)
Execution feedback: completed action produces ExecutionHandoff in KNOW
Proof closes loop: PROVE verifies outcome matched prediction, writes proof to KNOW
Succession works: successor package builds, validates, fresh Naya reconstructs

preconditions: All work_orders complete per their accept criteria
Arming gate passed: GATE live AND #1733 merged AND synthetic rehearsal green

machine_steps.do: Commit a pool of candidate held-out tasks BEFORE capture. Record pool hash.
machine_steps.verify: Pool hash published; tasks unseen by lesson author.

machine_steps.do: Capture one novel falsifiable lesson with capture contract (named task, pre-registered criterion, machine check).
machine_steps.verify: Admission gate accepts with reason code; invocation logged.

machine_steps.do: Run pipeline: persist -> index -> verify -> promote.
machine_steps.verify: DB learning_evidence.status=ACTIVE AND repo registry truth_state=ACTIVE within same run. Receipt IDs cross-referenced.

machine_steps.do: Fresh cold identity (never saw the lesson) retrieves via RANKED path and applies to a held-out task from the pool.
machine_steps.verify: Retrieval used nayanet_retrieve_blocks (ranked), not content-hash lookup. Application matches pre-registered prescription.

machine_steps.do: Blind different-seat verifier confirms the behavior change came from the lesson (task prompt published to rule out leakage).
machine_steps.verify: Verifier seat != builder seat. Lesson withheld from verifier until after scoring.

machine_steps.do: Publish hash-chained receipts for every link: capture->promotion->retrieval->behavior->proof.
machine_steps.verify: Each receipt carries SHA-256 of exact bytes. Chain verifiable by third party.

machine_steps.do: Repeat with a second lesson to prove the PROTOCOL is repeatable, not the run.
machine_steps.verify: Protocol hash recorded. Second run green.

human_steps.do: Shawn says 'smart note this' on a real lesson. Receives Smart Link.
Days later, different conversation, Shawn asks for something in that lesson's territory.
human_steps.verify: She does it the lesson's way WITHOUT being reminded.

human_steps.do: Shawn asks 'why did you do it that way?'
human_steps.verify: She answers in plain words, names the lesson, shows the receipt chain.
Resolves to a note whose header says ACTIVE, not CANDIDATE.

anti_gaming: Ranked retrieval required; content-hash lookup does not count.
Hand-inserted ACTIVE rows invalidate the run.
Verifier must be a different seat; lesson withheld until after scoring.
Task prompts published to rule out prompt leakage.
One green run is not proof; the repeatable protocol is.
